name: Reduce Moonwall dev test runtime via faster node startup

description: Baseline harness crash: tsx -e precheck used top-level await and failed before benchmark ran
Baseline harness for papi_dev benchmark; full test execution with node startup passes in 15.6s
Skip lsof-based RPC port discovery when --rpc-port is already explicit; wait for readiness directly on the known port
Opportunistically reuse warm startup cache for local dev nodes even when cacheStartupArtifacts is not explicitly enabled
Tried background dev/chopsticks network warmup during Vitest bootstrap with in-flight startup deduping; no improvement on papi_dev
Reduced local node readiness probe timeouts to retry faster; benchmark was unchanged on papi_dev and not worth extra flakiness risk
Tried dropping redundant --unsafe-force-node-key-generation when replacing --dev with raw chain spec and deterministic node key; benchmark regressed
Tried mtime-based warm startup-cache detection to avoid hashing the binary; slightly worse than current best on papi_dev
Tried removing --database=paritydb from default Moonbeam dev launch args for short-lived local nodes; papi_dev regressed
Tried removing --reserved-only from default Moonbeam dev launch args to trim startup overhead; no gain on papi_dev
Tried a persistent startup-cache fingerprint/index to reuse verified binary hashes across runs; papi_dev regressed to 14.6s
Sync dist in autoresearch.sh before timed runs so papi_dev benchmarks exercise current source; corrected baseline for the existing startup optimizations is 11.2s
Trim startup import overhead by bypassing the util barrel on the test startup path, using lightweight account constants, and lazy-loading provider/testing client libraries
Make account keyring creation lazy and lazy-load unused globalContext dependencies so papi_dev avoids paying zombie, legacy-node, and heavy constants startup costs
Tried lazy-loading dev handler helper imports and deferring foundation handler selection in runnerContext; papi_dev slipped to 9.20s
Trim more unused startup imports by lightening node binary validation and deferring contract/governance runtime dependencies off the papi_dev path
Tried removing --unsafe-rpc-external from the default Moonbeam dev args; papi_dev regressed slightly to 9.10s
Drop the default --rpc-cors=all flag from Moonbeam dev launches; local papi_dev does not need browser CORS and improved to 9.05s
Tried removing --unsafe-rpc-external after already dropping --rpc-cors=all; papi_dev regressed to 9.13s
Tried auto-enabling the Vitest dep optimizer for dev envs and prebundling moonwall/polkadot-api/web3 deps; papi_dev failed
Tried deferring the runnerContext import of globalContext into the test hooks; papi_dev regressed to 9.12s
Tried lazy proxy exports for ApiPromise and Web3 from the root moonwall entrypoint; papi_dev regressed slightly to 9.07s
Avoid importing StartupCacheService on the warm-cache path by resolving cached raw-spec and precompiled WASM artifacts directly in commandParsers
Lazy-load foundation handlers and dev helper dependencies so papi_dev avoids importing heavy unused handler code during test discovery
Cache a verified binary hash fingerprint for warm startup-cache lookup so commandParsers no longer re-hashes the Moonbeam binary every run
Bypass the heavy fileCheckers module on the common launcherChecks path and lazy-load prompt/download code only when already-running or missing-binary handling is actually needed
Lazy-proxy the root ApiPromise and Web3 re-exports so importing moonwall no longer eagerly loads heavy unused client libraries on papi_dev
Preload the dev node launcher module during foundation setup so startNetwork no longer pays that import penalty immediately before spawning the node
Start preloading the dev node launcher before command parsing so its import overlaps with handleDev setup work
Remove eager Prompter and DockerClient service imports from launcherCommon so the common dev preflight path only loads CommandRunner and FileSystem
Kick off the dev node launcher preload from MoonwallContext construction so even more of that import overlaps early setup work
Tried removing the CommandRunner service from launcherCommon in favor of direct execSync/execFileSync calls; papi_dev slipped slightly to 7.26s
Tried preloading the dev node launcher from testCmd via a global promise before commonChecks; papi_dev regressed slightly to 7.33s
Tried lazy-importing RpcPortDiscoveryService from launchNodeEffect so the explicit-port path would skip that module; papi_dev was effectively unchanged at 7.27s
Retried dropping --unsafe-force-node-key-generation after raw-spec substitution on the corrected harness; papi_dev regressed to 7.38s
Remove the default --reserved-only flag from Moonbeam dev launches; local papi_dev did not need it and improved to 7.24s
Retried removing --database=paritydb on the corrected harness; papi_dev regressed slightly to 7.26s
Tried deferring the unused globalContext imports out of runTests for the papi_dev path; benchmark regressed to 7.34s
